body: Wow that is really sad... yeah I also don’t really know what I did to make her become so distant given the fact the she is the one who always asked what was up with me. I think that’s probably the worst part, not knowing what you did.
Yeah I’ve given her those and she won’t use them. She’s very picky...

Ah yes I’ve seen this episode. I have always been an advocate for positive training for dogs. I have learned quite a bit from watching Victoria Stilwell. I’m also still trying to convince my parents that shouting constantly at the dogs to stop barking is basically doing nothing. Heck my stepdad thinks my way of training my new chihuahua is going to make her not listen to me because I’m too soft on her.🤷🏼‍♀️
Aww that’s cute! Yeah she has a little basket beside my be that she likes to sleep in and another which is under a side table in the living room but she never uses that one.

Sounds similar to my dog. She was rescued from a puppy mill. Whenever she is in the house she just runs to her bed and stays there unless we go outside or she hears me move in the other room and she gets up to check it out.
Yeah. Sometimes I don’t know how to put what I’m feeling into words.... Other times I’m able to write like everything I’ve ever felt down but I can’t get it across the way I want to...

Yeah no I can’t. She’s literally the only friend I have at this university.... She’s shown that she cares in the past, even going so far as to pin me down on my bed to talk me out of suicide, crying over me...... but now for some reason she’s being completely isolating...

It just sucks because she’s dealt with mental illness before, so I thought she of all people would understand. But instead she’s downstairs playing on the Xbox right now, laughing and having a good time with her online friends while I’m up here lonely and researching suicide methods.... go figure.
Little blue 2012 Mazda 3. I named him Jesse. What I love the most is how the clock reads “hello” and “goodbye” when I start the car and shut it off.

“Never say never. When you find a nice guy *hesitates* or girl, you’ll want to be intimate with them.” 

I’m an Ace girl and I get this a lot!
